findings: EquipmentBehaviors.id returns registry path only and rejects non-dynasty namespaces; it cannot distinguish marching_wine from tagged warming wine or identify vanilla lingering potion as poison_smoke_bomb.

Warm wine checks actual marching_wine item plus cod4WarmWine boolean. Drinking adds1200tick dimension-bound warmth, clears frost and returns a bottle in survival. Clone and dimension change clear transient warmth; a future task receipt must not copy or turn transient warmth into durable progression.

Poison smoke result is vanilla poison lingering potion with cod4PoisonSmoke tag and display metadata. Tooltip explicitly reads that tag. Vanilla poison behavior is retained; no extra dedicated smoke event handler found in bounded production text search, and no use-ownership acceptance inferred.

Wolf charm uses native tiger_claw plus slot0 wolf_fang. InfusionTraits specifically accepts wolf_fang on tiger_claw. Material record maps to shanxiao_claw; worn Curios accessory joins existing direct primary melee hit combo, every third hit60tick cooldown, not an independent proc/damage pipeline.

Crab charm uses scale_plate plus slot0 crab_shell. Material record maps to retaliation, ARMOR kind and ward family. Defense path requires real hostile attacker and heavy damage,160tick cooldown; boss knockback is suppressed but weakness remains. No new generic item registration should replace this identity.

InfusionMenu transaction validates owner/current menu/real BE/distance/revision/slot and problem status before copying preview. Apply costs exact material count and3 levels for noncreative, mutates existing base item and awards only first_infusion. Removing uses1level and no apply award. This is distinct from workbench crafting and should remain so.
Infusion table requires get_jade; the existing workbench recipes are a separate available path. A future optional quest must not silently impose the table gate on original workbench acquisition.

DynastyAdvancements.award resolves existing advancement then awards criterion code only; missing IDs return without creating a ledger. Future receipts should reuse the advancement system with explicit registered criteria, not create a second paid-reward ledger.
proposed_acceptance_cases: ordinary base item does not satisfy variant objective
display rename alone does not satisfy variant objective
actual recipe result with functional NBT satisfies exact designated objective
direct table infusion is not falsely recorded as crafting
no extra reward on repeated crafting/relogin
two players do not share actor receipt

no new item aliases or old-save world mutation
